title: sagus elata
intro: Sagus elata, commonly known as Chinese fir, is a species of coniferous tree that belongs to the cypress family (Cupressaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Sagus elata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve respiratory health, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Sagus elata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities.
